description: This header file declares internal API functions for managing an object array, including functions to get/set size, add/remove elements, access and modify entries, and manage growth behavior.

methods.name: AnscObjectArrayGetSize
methods.description: Retrieves the size (number of elements) of the object array.

methods.name: AnscObjectArraySetSize
methods.description: Sets the size of the object array, with an option to specify growth parameters.

methods.name: AnscObjectArrayRemoveAll
methods.description: Removes all elements from the object array.

methods.name: AnscObjectArrayGetAt
methods.description: Returns the data at a specified index in the array.

methods.name: AnscObjectArraySetAt
methods.description: Sets the data at a specified index in the array.

methods.name: AnscObjectArrayInsertAt
methods.description: Inserts data at a specified index, potentially shifting existing elements.

methods.name: AnscObjectArrayRemoveAt
methods.description: Removes a number of elements starting from a specified index.

methods.name: AnscObjectArrayAdd
methods.description: Adds an element to the end of the array and returns its index.

methods.name: AnscObjectArraySetGrowth
methods.description: Sets the growth rate for the array's resizing behavior.

methods.name: AnscObjectArrayFind
methods.description: Finds the index of the specified data within the array.
